execution.build: New per-cell guarded build, optimized -j2; fixed source SHA; serial by default
execution.run: Existing guarded remote_experiment run/start lock; do not bypass or reuse a successful ID
execution.order: Reference first, accept its all-input accounting before launching zero controls; one simulation at a time
execution.resource_gate: Fresh other-user/job and system audit before first build/run and material changes; keep existing worker thresholds; preserve sampled resource receipt, never call snapshots a peak

required_checks: All 104 input tuples and 201981952 payload bytes complete exactly once; no windows or completion filtering
Original demand origins using common legacy ns3 double-to-Time conversion; verify_ws31_fct.py must pass
Zero controls byte-identical full FCT to reference
Normalized ordered WS30_CHOICE and WS30_ROUTE stream hashes identical; remove only uid field, preserve all times/identities/ports and choice values
No within-QP output-port changes; no WS30_OBSERVATION_OVERFLOW; full row budget 1000000
C2-zero launch wait=0 for every flow; demand/launch/finish observations agree with FCT; no pending/cancelled/unfinished or byte imbalance
Common config, fixed source and input hashes; all old special fixtures OFF; no Ofan/RR modes
stop_conditions: Any missing/extra/duplicate flow, byte/time inconsistency, zero-control FCT/path mismatch or observation overflow
scope: Technical correctness/resource pilot only; no effects evidence, no additional baseline, no Ofan work
after_success: Return local raw/logs/manifests and independent handoff; main acceptance before further dynamic modes
after_failure: Preserve failed ID and raw/logs, stop remaining cells, main fixes with new SHA/ID
